review: Optional Windows CJK font fallback source review
scope: Compared current gui.rs with runtime/gui-font-fallback-base/gui.rs; only this file was changed for the group.
checks: Existing proportional-family stack is captured before Ouroboros registration, then phosphor is appended; the optional CJK font is appended afterward to every family, so existing UI and icon fonts remain first.

The helper treats missing/unreadable/non-file/empty/oversized fonts as unavailable and leaves definitions unchanged; reading is capped at 32 MiB plus one sentinel byte, and the sentinel detects/rejects oversize data before installing it.
WINDIR is optional; the code attempts only the standard Fonts/malgun.ttf path and does not affect other systems or add a runtime dependency.
The test covers a missing optional font and verifies families/font names are unchanged.

limitation.finding: A readable malformed/replaced font can reach epaint FontFace::new, which unwraps parser failure into panic (pinned source: E:/.cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-1949cf8c6b5b557f/epaint-0.34.3/src/text/fonts.rs, FontsImpl::new around line 782).
limitation.assessment: Not a blocker for ordinary loading of the stock Windows system font; malformed-file fallback is not guaranteed and remains a narrow robustness limitation.

validation: Source review only; no Cargo or application run.
